initial_recommendation: v1 MEDIANCUT had better grouped planes than MAXCOVERAGE; independent review requested a single crop/cluster refinement.
method_disclosure: Substantive built-in imagegen drawing, followed by explicit NN resizing and 32-color quantization. Does not constitute native pixel-by-pixel completion.
